# The SHA-256 of every file in the pinned encoder commit (the one in
# encoder-revision.txt) of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, in
# `sha256sum` form. publish-image.yml copies each pushed image's Hugging Face
# cache out without running the image, and image_sbom.py check-model refuses
# the image unless every file under the pinned snapshot is listed here with
# these bytes, so a bake that stored other weights under the pin's name is
# never tagged (security review R46).
#
# Regenerate only with a new pin: list the commit's files from the hub API
# (/api/models/<repo>/tree/<commit>?recursive=true), take each LFS file's
# sha256 oid, and hash each other file fetched at that commit after checking
# its git blob id against the listing. Authored in the private upstream under
# publish/overlays/; a test there keeps the pin and this list together.
